steps.action: Freeze exact reviewed release, fixture OPEN/EMPTY targets, enrollment capsules, native case matrix and collector hashes; retain source gates. Unknown values stop activation.
Checkpoint active tasks and predeclare normal app quit, exact owned daemon shutdown and supported hook configuration backup/restore. No broad process kill or unspecified global plugin refresh.

Before launching candidate app/engine, independently audit local-only identity scope and all authority-group privileges, then run protected admit-reader with reviewed root-owned audit. Every admitted reader may read the entire included capsule source/history.
Independent operator admits matching Root /1 epoch/generation, reader UID/GID, release tuple and execution policy/floor. Leave hostQualification null. Signer and installer never admit their own root.

Fresh normal app and shared engine launch after group membership change; launch actual CLI with --remote unix://<exact socket> from the dedicated repository. Observe actual consumer uid/euid and effective groups, boot/app/engine births, reciprocal socket identity and hook child cwd. Wrong cwd or stale credentials stops campaign.

Render one combined plugin hooks/hooks.json retaining SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and SessionEnd and replacing only the legacy Stop with the protected absolute Stop command. Do not also load the Stop-only proposal. Review exact hashes with CLI /hooks; verify effective hooks/list and fresh-task cache adoption. Record precise prior marketplace/version/artifact/trust/enable state for rollback.

Execute only the 12 separately predeclared candidate documents: four OPEN, four EMPTY, two expiry, two revocation. Publish OPEN once immediately before O-D1 and EMPTY once immediately before E-D1. Keep each handle unchanged through its phases. Expiry/failure stops; no renewal loop or return to OPEN.

Failure, abandonment or later teardown only: independently revoke candidate root and remove campaign, restore the exact prior hook configuration, and run withdraw-reader before ending owned candidate processes. Old open descriptors are not claimed revoked. Successful evidence review may instead preserve the measured runtime under the qualification handoff below.

Success handoff only after complete actual native evidence: remove the campaign, preserve root/floor/reader/publication/release and the exact live measured runtime with the intended final combined hooks, then independently admit existing completed HostQualification fields. Do not restore legacy Stop or fabricate evidence. Unverified same-lifetime hook restoration or app restart blocks this handoff; a later fresh launch cannot inherit old AppInstance pins.

phases.activeSelection: Publish this fresh OPEN handle only once immediately before O-D1; reuse unchanged through O-D1/O-D2/O-C1/O-C2. Do not prepublish EMPTY.
After all OPEN phases close, clean checkout fixed EMPTY and publish this fresh handle once immediately before E-D1; reuse unchanged for the remaining eight candidate phases.
